description: Land Acquisition - Ujekale, Kobeigane D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land lots for public purpose (road widening), including descriptions of land parcels, claimants, and compensation procedures. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition, property ownership transfers, and land-related administrative procedures.
